Results.ReviewText: I purchased the Spirit II and it has been a great grill! The grill heats up quickly, evenly distributes the heat, and has robust construction. ClientResponses.Response:
Congratulations on your new Weber Spirit II E-310! If your grill is located in a coastal or humid area additional maintenance will be needed to keep up the appearance of the exterior steel parts. Below are a couple of helpful tips!
1. At the first sign of staining/discoloration/surface rust, we recommend cleaning with stainless steel cleaner. Once cleaned, we recommend using a stainless steel polish to keep it looking its best in-between cleanings.
2. Once a week, we would recommend wiping down the grill with a wet towel or rag and then drying completely.
3. We would only recommend covering your grill if you know inclement weather is coming.
If you continue to experience issues with rusting, please contact us. We are ready to help! Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
